args.subject: Child seat availability in London
args.body:
Hello New Car Rental,

Do you have child seats available for car rentals in London? If so, please let me know which types you offer, any additional charges, and whether they need to be reserved in advance.

Thank you,
Emma Johnson

final_text: I emailed New Car Rental at **support@newcarrental.co.uk**, the address listed in a customer review, asking whether they offer child seats in London, which types are available, any extra charges, and whether advance booking is required.
